projectDescription: A desktop-first AI agent application that lets you manage multiple concurrent AI coding and research sessions with a polished multi-session inbox, deep integrations, and customizable automation.
keyFeatures: Multi-session inbox with Kanban-style workflow (Todo → In Progress → Needs Review → Done)
Claude Agent SDK + Pi SDK dual-backend for Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Copilot, and custom providers
Sources: zero-config integrations with MCP servers, REST APIs (Google, Slack, Microsoft, GitHub), and local filesystems
Skills: reusable per-workspace agent instruction bundles invokable via slash commands
Automations: event-driven workflows triggered by labels, cron schedules, status changes, and agent tool events
Three permission modes: Explore (read-only), Ask to Edit, Auto
Headless/remote server mode: run sessions on a VPS and connect the desktop app as a thin client
VS Code-style multi-file diff viewer with real-time streaming
File attachments: drag-and-drop images, PDFs, Office docs with auto-conversion
Background tasks with progress tracking for long-running operations
publicApiSurface: CLI: craft-cli ping / health / versions / workspaces / sessions / connections / sources
WebSocket RPC: sessions:create, sessions:sendMessage, sessions:cancel, sessions:delete
WebSocket RPC: sources:get, sources:create, sources:update, sources:delete
WebSocket RPC: skills:get, skills:create, skills:update, skills:delete
Server env: CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN, CRAFT_RPC_HOST, CRAFT_RPC_PORT, CRAFT_RPC_TLS_CERT, CRAFT_RPC_TLS_KEY
